title: A test keeps an entry machine Online for three minutes after it stops, while the journey says it must not stay Online for minutes
what: The journey for the entry machine card says the pill turns Offline within about 30 seconds and must never stay Online for minutes after the machine stops. The test of the status rule says a machine is still Online exactly 3 minutes after its last call. So either the journey or the rule is wrong, and the test locks in the rule.
expected: The journey and the test agree on how long a silent machine may still show Online.
how_often: every time a machine loses its internet
fix_line: Decide the right time, then fix the journey or the rule and its test to match

title: The owner-only rule and the number rules for entry machines are checked only by reading the server change's text
what: The checks that only the owner can add or remove a machine, and that a taken number or another gym's serial is refused, read the words of a database change that is marked not applied. Nothing runs that change against a database, so a wrong rule would still pass.
expected: A database test that runs the entry machine calls as owner, staff and a second gym and checks the refusals.
fix_line: Add a database test that calls the entry machine functions as each role once the change goes live

title: Many entry machine screens are never tested: the staff view, the no-number card, Keep it, the reload, Try again
what: The one browser test of entry machines is signed in as the owner. It never shows the screen to staff, never shows 'No machine number yet' or 'Give a number' (it gives every member a number first), never presses 'Keep it', never reloads after a remove, and never shows the failed-read or gym-not-online messages on screen. The pill changing by itself is never watched.
expected: A browser test covers each of these states for the owner and for staff.
fix_line: Add browser steps for the staff view, the no-number card, Keep it, a reload and the error states

title: The WhatsApp and Call buttons on Enquiries are never pressed in a test
what: No test presses WhatsApp on an enquiry or a referred friend, or reads the Call link's number. So nothing checks that the message names the gym, goes to that person's number only, opens without sending by itself, or that the number has its country code.
expected: A browser test presses Call and WhatsApp on an ordinary, a referred and a web chat enquiry and checks the number and message.
fix_line: Add test steps that press Call and WhatsApp and check the address

title: The Add enquiry warnings, refusals, Saving and failed save are never seen on screen
what: The tests fill the Add enquiry sheet only on the happy path. 'Type their name.', the warning that someone already asked from this number, 'Use at most <n> letters.', 'No date: it goes under Later.', the Saving button, a failed save keeping the typed values, a double press and the empty-list words are never checked on screen.
expected: A browser test drives each of these on the Add enquiry sheet.
fix_line: Add browser steps for the Add enquiry refusals, warnings and failed save

title: The 'Why did they not join?' reason box is never tested
what: The not-interested test checks the bar, the move and Reopen, but never picks a reason, never checks that 'Add as member' and 'Follow-up date' leave the row, and never checks that a reopened enquiry loses its reason.
expected: A browser test picks a reason, checks it stays on that enquiry only, and checks it is cleared on Reopen.
fix_line: Add steps for the reason box and Reopen clearing it

title: The thank-you sheet's failure, cannot-give notes and staff view are checked only as data
what: The free days thank-you is tested on screen only when it works. The red line after a failed save and the retry, the notes for an inviter who is not on the list or has no plan, the inviter with no plan getting no sheet, and staff seeing no give button are only checked inside the logic, never on screen.
expected: A browser test shows each of these states, including as staff.
fix_line: Add browser steps for the failed save, the cannot-give notes and the staff view

title: Help and feedback's AI answer, its Yes and No and the team's reply are never seen on screen
what: Sending…, 'Waiting for the answer', the AI answer with 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.', 'Did this solve it?' with Yes and No and their thanks, and the team's reply with its New mark are only checked in the logic. The real-gym screen test reaches only the help pages' answer.
expected: A browser test in a real gym sends a question, gets an AI answer, taps Yes or No, and sees a team reply marked New once.
fix_line: Add a browser test of the AI answer, the rating and a team reply

title: The MettleUp access card's off, failed and Cancel states are never seen on screen
what: The browser tests only open and close support access. 'MettleUp access is not switched on for your gym yet.', a failed read of the list with the ask button blocked, Cancel on the sheet, and a refused open are never shown in a test.
expected: A browser test shows each of these states and checks nothing opens.
fix_line: Add browser steps for the switched-off card, a failed list, Cancel and a refused open
